mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item(cart_item_no, cart_no, product_option_no, quantity) VALUES (seq_cart_item.nextval, #{cartNo}, #{productOptionNo}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT cart_item_no, cart_no, product_option_no, quantity, created_at FROM cart_item

SELECT ci.cart_item_no AS cartItemNo, ci.cart_no AS cartNo, ci.product_option_no AS productOptionNo, ci.quantity AS quantity, ci.created_at AS createdAt, p.name AS productName, po.color AS color, po.option_size AS sizeName, p.price AS price, CASE WHEN img.image_url IS NOT NULL THEN '/upload/' || img.image_url ELSE NULL END AS imageUrl FROM cart_item ci JOIN cart c ON ci.cart_no = c.cart_no JOIN product_option po ON ci.product_option_no = po.product_option_no JOIN product p ON po.product_no = p.product_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_no, image_url FROM ( SELECT pi.product_no, pi.image_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pi.product_no ORDER BY CASE WHEN pi.image_type = 'THUMB' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, NVL(pi.sort_order, 9999) ) AS rn FROM product_img pi ) WHERE rn = 1 ) img ON p.product_no = img.product_no WHERE c.member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY ci.cart_item_no DESC
SELECT cart_item_no, cart_no, product_option_no, quantity, created_at FROM cart_item WHERE cart_no = #{cartNo} AND product_option_no = #{productOptionNo}
SELECT COUNT(ci.cart_item_no) FROM cart c JOIN cart_item ci ON c.cart_no = ci.cart_no WHERE c.member_no = #{memberNo}

SELECT ci.cart_item_no AS cartItemNo, p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS productName, po.option_size AS optionSize, po.color AS color, ci.quantity AS quantity, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate FROM cart c JOIN cart_item ci ON c.cart_no = ci.cart_no JOIN product_option po ON ci.product_option_no = po.product_option_no JOIN product p ON po.product_no = p.product_no WHERE c.member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY ci.cart_item_no DESC
